messages:
Priya (Sales AE): Heads up 999HelixCorp needs a 30-day air-gapped POC for our Private deployment. Theyre asking for an install preflight, how we provide ephemeral API access via a bastion, and a clear list of ports/ICs to open. Can we draft this ASAP?
Elena (Sales Eng): I can own the preflight doc. Quick asks: do they want full model sync or just a small test artifact (100MB)?
HelixCorp-ops: Small test artifact is fine. We'll mirror images as needed to local registry.
Marcus (Finance): For pricing: Dedicated pool for POC (8x A100 equivalent) = pro-rated monthly commit. I can give a formal quote but ballpark is ~ $28k for 30 days.
Rafael (Infra Eng): Technical preflight items (high level):
- Hardware: GPU model, firmware, driver version
- OS kernel and required modules (nvidia, vfio if passthrough)
- Container runtime: containerd >=1.5 or docker-ce >=20.10 plus cri shim
- K8s: supported versions 1.23-1.26 (we'll include matrix)
- Cgroup: cgroup v1 recommended, call out runtimes that support v2
- Time sync + NTP/chrony
- SELinux/AppArmor guidance
- Local registry mirror + image list
Rafael (Infra Eng): Provide short commands customers can run locally: 
```bash
# GPU + driver
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version --format=csv
# CUDA or toolkit
if command -v nvcc >/dev/null; then nvcc --version; else ls /usr/local | grep cuda || true; fi
# Kernel
uname -r; lsmod | egrep 'nvidia|nvrm' || true
# CRI
ps -ef | egrep 'containerd|dockerd' || true
```
Nadia (FieldTech): For air-gapped installs we require these artifacts mirrored:
- installer helm chart tarball
- runtime images (inference runtime, sidecars, device plugin, dcgm)
- model artifact (optional small sample)
We provide a mirror script to push to their registry.
Sam (Solutions Engineer): Ephemeral API access flow we support (summary):
1) Sales creates a scoped POC session in Console (metadata: org, project, duration, allowed models).
2) Console issues a signed grant (JWT-like blob) with an expiration.
3) Customer bastion POSTs grant to our validate endpoint over mTLS to exchange for short-lived session creds.
4) Session creds are valid only for the POC duration and limited scopes.
Elena (Sales Eng): Can we document the exact TLS requirements for the exchange? HelixCorp InfoSec will need cipher suites and cert fingerprinting.
Rafael (Infra Eng): Yes. Requirements: mutual TLS with client certs (RSA/P-256), TLS1.2+; cipher suites ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256 or ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256. We'll include example openssl commands to generate a CSR and verify.
HelixCorp-ops: For mirror, do you support GCR/Quay/Harbor?
Nadia (FieldTech): We support any registry with Docker v2 API. We ship a small tool that syncs tags and manifests. We'll provide an example config for Harbor.
Priya (Sales AE): InfoSec also asked about KMS and key custody during POC. They plan to use on-site Vault. Does Redwood need export access to keys?
Rafael (Infra Eng): No. Our agent only needs an endpoint to call encrypt/decrypt via transit. Keys remain in their Vault. We never store raw keys. We'll note that only PKCS#11/HSM-backed transit is supported for private POCs.
Marcus (Finance): Elena, attach the price sheet and include a sentence about additional support hours (onsite/remote) billed separately.
deploy-bot: poc/helixcorp/1860123456 created by Elena
Elena (Sales Eng): I'll assemble the one-page preflight + a 2-paragraph FAQ covering ephemeral tokens, mirror flow, and basic troubleshooting.
Rafael (Infra Eng): Also call out common pitfalls: 
- SELinux in Enforcing can block device plugin mounts (recommend Permissive during install)
- Older kernels (<5.4) may need patching for modern CUDA stacks
- cgroup v2: if using docker legacy runtime you may need to enable systemd cgroup driver and verify runtime flags
- Missing node labels/taints will prevent scheduling to the GPU pool
Elena (Sales Eng): For InfoSec, I'll include a minimal network diagram: bastion (mTLS) -> control plane (6443) -> node ports for health checks; optional outbound 443 to our artifact proxy if customers allow it.
HelixCorp-ops: We'll run the provided commands on 3 nodes tomorrow 09:30 PST and upload results here.
Priya (Sales AE): Thanks all. Elena, Rafael 999please have the PDF preflight by EOD today so I can hand to HelixCorp legal. Marcus will follow up on the formal quote.
Marcus (Finance): Will send a line-item quote by EOD.
Rafael (Infra Eng): I'll review output and highlight blockers. If we hit kernel/driver mismatches, we'll list remediation steps.
Elena (Sales Eng): Copy. I'll post the PDF here when ready.
Priya (Sales AE): Awesome 999closing loop until Helix uploads checks. Thanks!
